cards.text: Last time, Joab killed Abner in Hebron (2 Samuel 3:27). Abner was the commander of Saul's army, the man who made Saul's son Ish-bosheth king over Israel (2 Samuel 2:8-9). Now that news is headed straight for Ish-bosheth.

cards.question: Ish-bosheth son of Saul hears that Abner has died in Hebron. How does he take it?
Ish-bosheth is the only one in Israel who is shaken by the news about Abner.

cards.text: Saul's son has two men who lead raiding parties, Baanah and Rechab, sons of Rimmon the Beerothite. And the writer leans over with a side note: the Beerothites fled to Gittaim and have lived there as foreigners to this day.

cards.question: Baanah and Rechab, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, are from the tribe of Judah.

cards.text: Now the writer steps aside to tell us about someone else. Jonathan son of Saul had a son who was five years old when the report about Saul and Jonathan came from Jezreel, and his nurse picked him up and fled.

cards.question: As the nurse hurries to escape with Jonathan's five-year-old son, what happens to the boy?

answers.text: He is captured on the road
He is left behind in Jezreel

cards.question: Jonathan's son, the boy who fell, is named ___.

cards.text: Now back to Rechab and Baanah. The two brothers set out for Ish-bosheth's house and get there in the heat of the day.

cards.question: Rechab and Baanah arrive in the heat of the day, while the king is taking his midday ___.
How do Rechab and Baanah get into the interior of Ish-bosheth's house?

answers.text: As if to get some wheat
As if to bring him a report
As if to guard his room

cards.text: Inside, they stab him in the stomach, the same way Joab killed Abner (2 Samuel 3:27). Then Rechab and his brother Baanah slip away.
Here's the rest of what happened in that house. Rechab and Baanah went in while Ish-bosheth was lying on his bed, and after they killed him, they took something with them.

cards.question: What do Rechab and Baanah take from Ish-bosheth?
Rechab and Baanah travel all night by way of the Arabah and bring Ish-bosheth's head to David at ___.

cards.text: They tell the king, "Here is the head of Ish-bosheth son of Saul, your enemy who sought your life." I bet these two think they're about to be named employees of the month.

cards.question: Rechab and Baanah tell David what the LORD has done for him today. What do they say?

answers.text: Granted him vengeance on Saul's family
Paid him back for Abner's death
Given him peace with all of Israel

cards.text: But David answers them with an oath, by the LORD who has redeemed his life from all distress. Friend, that is NOT how an "attaboy" starts.

cards.question: David reminds Rechab and Baanah of the man who told him Saul was dead and thought he was bringing good news. David says he rewarded that man with a gift.
David tells Rechab and Baanah that wicked men have killed a ___ man in his own house and on his own bed.

cards.text: David says he will require Ish-bosheth's blood from their hands. So David commands his young men, and they kill Rechab and Baanah, cut off their hands and feet, and hang their bodies by the pool in Hebron.

cards.question: What do David's young men do with the head of Ish-bosheth?

answers.text: Bury it in Abner's tomb in Hebron
Return it to Mahanaim for burial
Hang it by the pool in Hebron

cards.text: And that's where we'll leave it for now, friend. Saul's son is gone, but the story of David and the throne isn't finished yet.
